summary: God answered Job out of a whirlwind, asking him about the wonders of creation. Job saw that God is far bigger and wiser than he could imagine.

story_reel.narration: Job had asked God many questions. Why did this happen? Where are You? Finally, God answered, out of a mighty storm! But instead of explaining everything, God asked Job questions. 'Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you understand! Who decided how big it would be? Who told the ocean, This far and no farther? Have you ever commanded the morning to begin? Can you send lightning bolts and make them say, Here we are? Who gives the horse its strength? Does the eagle fly high because you command it?' God talked about lions, ravens, mountain goats, wild donkeys, ostriches, and enormous creatures in the sea. Question after question showed Job how big, wise, and powerful God is. God didn't tell Job every reason. But He showed Job something even better: Himself. When you don't understand what's happening, remember who holds the whole world.

scenes.caption: Out of the storm
scenes.art_direction: A great whirlwind on the horizon, radiant with light; Job shielding his eyes. Awe, not fear.

scenes.caption: The foundations of the earth
scenes.art_direction: Planet earth assembling like a model, mountains placed like building blocks.

scenes.caption: This far and no farther
scenes.art_direction: Ocean waves rushing up to a shoreline and stopping exactly at a glowing line.

scenes.caption: Lightning says 'Here we are!'
scenes.art_direction: Playful lightning bolts bowing in the sky.

scenes.caption: Horse, eagle, and more
scenes.art_direction: Majestic animal montage: galloping horse, soaring eagle, ostrich, mountain goats.

scenes.caption: Job sees God
scenes.art_direction: Job kneeling, small against the wide sky, peaceful.

memory_verse.text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh is bigger and wiser than any problem I face.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: God showed Job how big and wise He is. What is a question you would like to ask God?

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You are so big and so wise! When I don't understand what's happening, help me remember that You hold the whole world, and You hold me. Amen.

companion.message: God didn't give Job every answer, but He gave Job Himself. And that was enough. You can bring your big questions to Him too.
